Name: Panty Time
Author: Acurizee
Description:
[color=#ff0000][size=4][b][i]Description[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Add panties from the single women of the Valley[/color]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b][i]Installation instructions[/i][/b][/size][/color]
Just install it in your Mods folder

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][i]Main features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Add panties as in-game items. For now, I don't know how to categorize them as quest items, which is why they're listed as “tools.”
These items will appear after you receive an email when you have 8 hearts with your favorite bachelorette. After that, the item will appear in some random locations. You can choose not to turn it in and use Emily's sewing machine to turn them into clothes you can wear, or you can keep them as is.

P.S.: It’s programmed so that after completing the mission, on random days afterward, the NPC will give you the item again with a special dialogue.[/color]

[size=4][b][color=#ffff00][i]Requirements[/i][/color][/b][/size]
You need BETAS for the items to appear.

Manifest.Name: Panty Time
Manifest.Description: Add the panties of the sweetest bachelorettes in town.
Manifest.Author: Shadow
